requirement: Return every live pathogen as an id and name item, sorted by name ascending and read without tracking; soft-deleted pathogens are excluded by the query filter.

preconditions.text: The pathogen table contains the rows seeded for the case
One of the seeded pathogens is soft-deleted

inputs.text: Query with no parameters over pathogens inserted out of order
Query with no parameters over live pathogens plus a soft-deleted one
Query with no parameters on an empty database

returns.text: Success with the pathogen list projected as id and name pairs
An empty list is returned when no live pathogen exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
